MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub fits my need to connect a keyboard receiver and other computer peripherals, and individual switches would make those connections easier to manage.",
    "The 64GB card and USB 3.0 reader offer a plausible expansion for my Raspberry Pi and a convenient way to transfer files, provided the card is compatible."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV devices and Echo products do not solve the connectivity, organization, or maintenance needs reflected in my recent choices.",
    "Another similar 32GB card feels redundant after my earlier SanDisk interaction and recent GPS card selection; the larger card and reader offer a clearer additional use.",
    "Headphones and an HDMI cable do not mean I need optical audio cables or bulk speaker wire, and I have no current project requiring a two-way radio."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in streaming devices and voice-controlled gadgets without a specific use for them.",
    "My past interest in memory cards and audio accessories seems to have been treated as a reason to suggest more of the same, without considering capacity, connections, or what I already have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, network cables, headphone mount, backpack, and duster point toward making my computer workspace more connected, organized, and easier to maintain.",
    "Useful additions need a specific role: connecting existing peripherals or expanding compatible storage matters more to me than simply adding another electronic device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my computer accessory needs but extended them too broadly into unrelated electronics and redundant purchases."
}
